notes: All credentials and domains are inert test values.
Checks/exchanges are independent cases, not a sequential live-server transcript.
Policy arbitration is a fixed golden scenario; consumers must use their production implementation, not a fixture-specific model.
Invalid cases require semantic validation after serde, not merely JSON deserialization.
Ordinary settings remain opaque JSON on the server; per-key client-schema rejection is deliberately excluded from the shared invalid corpus.
